title: Blood Pressure Tracker
description: Log blood pressure readings with automatic AHA category classification, averages and history saved in your browser.
howto: Enter your systolic (top) and diastolic (bottom) numbers.
Press Add reading — it is saved in your browser with a timestamp.
Watch your average and AHA category update; clear history anytime.

faqs.a: Per the American Heart Association: Normal is below 120/80, Elevated is 120-129/<80, Stage 1 is 130-139 or 80-89, Stage 2 is 140+ or 90+, and above 180/120 is a hypertensive crisis — seek emergency care.
Only in this browser's local storage on your device. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Sit quietly 5 minutes first, feet flat, arm supported at heart level. Measure at the same times daily for comparable readings.
